stories.summary: PM Lawrence Wong arrived in Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit (15–17 Nov), where leaders will discuss economic integration, energy security and the green transition; the landmark ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement was signed on 14 Nov, and Singapore takes over the ASEAN chairmanship in 2027.
stories.title: PM Lawrence Wong in Manila for ASEAN Summit
stories.why: The digital economy pact is the first legally binding regionwide deal of its kind, and the summit sets up Singapore's chairmanship year.

stories.summary: SIA Group's first-half net profit fell 43.9% to S$134 million as high fuel costs squeezed earnings, even as revenue rose 16.8% to S$11.3 billion on strong passenger and cargo demand.
stories.title: Singapore Airlines Group's profit nearly halves as fuel costs bite
stories.why: Fuel costs are eating the flag carrier's margins despite record revenue — a squeeze felt across the airline industry.

stories.summary: The Bank of England, MAS and the Bank of Thailand said Project Meridian FX showed synchronised settlement can work across three currencies, with banks settling simulated FX trades via tokenised central bank money; a live synchronisation interface is planned for 2028.
stories.title: UK, Singapore, Thailand test cross-border FX settlement
stories.why: It is a concrete step toward faster, lower-risk cross-border payments between the three financial centres.

stories.summary: About 140,000 work pass holder records were compromised in the breach of Fullerton Health's Migrant Worker Primary Care Plan server, including names, FIN numbers, dates of birth and addresses; no health or financial data was affected, and the firm is building a new server from scratch.
stories.title: Records of about 140,000 migrant workers exposed in Fullerton Health's recent data breach
stories.why: It is the largest disclosure yet from the recent string of healthcare cyberattacks in Singapore.

stories.summary: More people with Type 1 diabetes will be eligible for subsidies on advanced insulin delivery systems from March 2027, as diabetes affects one in 11 Singaporeans.
stories.title: World Diabetes Day: Type 1 diabetes patients to get subsidies for advanced insulin systems
stories.why: It widens access to costly diabetes technology for a common chronic condition.

stories.summary: A petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate ousted CEO Jensen Huang passed 115,000 signatures, including 5,965 current employees and 63,063 shareholders, with Elon Musk, Replit's Amjad Masad and Epic's Tim Sweeney among supporters; two major shareholders separately urged the board to take its time and keep Huang's return on the table.
stories.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
stories.why: The campaign shows the pressure on Nvidia's board days before its first earnings call without Huang on 17 Nov.

stories.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet on 13 Nov, letting its "dots" AI agents complete purchases with tokenised card details and a security check on every transaction; the rollout is limited to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers with eligible US-issued cards.
stories.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
stories.why: It moves AI agents from finding products to actually paying for them — a first for a mainstream chatbot.

stories.summary: Tesla invited select customers to order the steering-wheel-free Cybercab for personal use at $29,990 plus a $1,000 deposit, with deliveries estimated in December in Austin — but the car will not move without a $299-a-month Autonomy Subscription and only operates where Tesla's robotaxi service runs.
stories.title: Tesla Cybercab orders open: $29,990 plus $299 a month
stories.why: It turns the robotaxi from a hail-able service into a product you can buy — with a subscription toll on every mile.

stories.summary: US transport secretary Sean Duffy said a copper wire upgrade overloaded routers and caused the telecommunications outage that grounded all US departures for more than four hours on Friday, the first nationwide ground stop since January 2023, with over 4,000 flights cancelled.
stories.title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight chaos, US transport secretary says
stories.why: It pins the worst US air-travel disruption in years on ageing infrastructure, days after the FAA expanded an AI air-traffic system.

stories.summary: Italy's competition authority fined Meta about $887 million over how Facebook accessed Android users' gallery photos and videos, in one of the largest European privacy penalties against the company.
stories.title: Meta Fined $887 Million in Italy Over Android Gallery Photos and Videos on Facebook
stories.why: It adds a major European fine to Meta's running regulatory battles over data use.

stories.summary: The Federal Reserve's semiannual Financial Stability Report found AI the top-cited risk to the financial system, named by 87% of market contacts — up from 50% in May — citing cyberattacks, complex AI financing and the risk of an AI earnings slowdown triggering a broad market correction.
stories.title: AI rockets to top of worries about financial system in latest Fed survey
stories.why: The Fed's own survey now puts AI valuations at the centre of systemic risk, just as Nvidia's turmoil rattles markets.

stories.summary: After more than US$50 billion in foreign outflows since September 2024, Indian equities are showing early signs of a turnaround, with AI-risk diversification, global underweights, compressed valuations and an earnings recovery cited as catalysts.
stories.title: Foreign investors are buying Indian stocks again. 4 catalysts that could make them stay
stories.why: A durable return of foreign money to India would mark a shift in emerging-market flows.

stories.summary: CSRC chairman Wu Qing said China will provide greater certainty through its institutional framework and deepen research into long-term market-stability mechanisms, as global capital markets undergo a new round of asset repricing and rebalancing.
stories.title: China to offer greater institutional certainty as global capital markets rebalance
stories.why: Beijing is signalling steadier rules for its 200-million-plus retail investors as global markets reprice.

stories.summary: The Straits Times Index fell 1% to 5,231.84 on Friday, with Genting Singapore down 5.7% to a one-year low a day after reporting a 42.2% fall in third-quarter net profit to S$54.7 million.
stories.title: Genting Singapore hits one-year low amid broader fall of Singapore stocks; STI down 1%
stories.why: Singapore stocks are caught in the same AI-led sell-off dragging global markets.

stories.summary: Australia and the Philippines are set to sign a new defence cooperation agreement in Manila today, modernising a 1995 framework to deepen military coordination, infrastructure cooperation and joint training, with PM Anthony Albanese attending.
stories.title: Australia and Philippines prepare new defence pact amid rising South China Sea tensions
stories.why: It hardens a key regional security partnership as South China Sea tensions rise.

stories.summary: The Trump administration's cuts to roughly 80,000 US troops in Europe are now expected to be far smaller than feared — about 5,000 — after allies raised NATO defence spending and the Pentagon weighed how much it relies on European bases for the Middle East war.
stories.title: Pentagon eyes smaller troop cuts across Europe in reversal
stories.why: It eases European fears of a US pullback while the Iran war drags on.

stories.summary: A UN conference in Geneva starting Monday will discuss curbs on lethal autonomous weapons that can select and engage targets without human intervention, amid warnings the world is close to crossing a moral red line on autonomous targeting of humans.
stories.title: Lethal autonomous weapons: Why the UN is scrambling to regulate 'killer robots'
stories.why: AI-driven weapons are already being used in Ukraine and Iran, and there is still no legal framework governing them.

stories.summary: Finland's defence chief called it outrageous to demand Finland leave NATO, pushing back against Russian pressure on the alliance's newest member.
stories.title: Finnish defense chief: 'Outrageous' to demand Finland leave NATO
stories.why: It shows how directly Moscow is now pressing NATO's Nordic members.

stories.summary: Hackers suspected of links to Iran have hit US water systems, two oil tankers heading for Texas and supermarket refrigeration in France, pushing fridge temperatures as high as 49°C and spoiling food; US and French officials attribute the attacks to Iran, which denies involvement.
stories.title: Water Systems, Oil Tankers, Supermarkets Hit As Iran Escalates Cyber War
stories.why: Cyberattacks on civilian infrastructure are becoming a front in the US–Iran war.

stories.summary: Germany's parliament voted 309–190 to let the BND run covert operations abroad — including shutting down state-backed hacking servers, disrupting disinformation networks and interfering with weapons supply chains — and the domestic BfV to act against threats at home for the first time.
stories.title: Germany gives its spies powers to hack and sabotage abroad
stories.why: Berlin is moving from intelligence-gathering to active disruption of hybrid threats from Russia, China and Iran.

tldr: Singapore: PM Wong arrives in Manila as ASEAN signs its first regionwide digital economy pact.
Technology: Petition to reinstate Nvidia's Jensen Huang passes 115,000 signatures, backed by Elon Musk.
Finance & global markets: The Fed names AI the top threat to financial stability, cited by 87% of market contacts.
Defence & military developments: Australia and the Philippines sign a new defence pact in Manila today amid South China Sea tensions.
Information warfare & Information Operations: Iran is suspected of escalating cyberattacks on water systems, oil tankers and supermarkets.
